## Illumina, Inc. (ILMN) `[Specialty Materials & IP Licensing]`
- Illumina entered the S&P 500 before the open on September 21, 2026; index inclusion was identified as a source of potential passive-fund demand during the September 24 session. (Quiver Quant)
- Illumina’s second-quarter 2026 update raised full-year reported-revenue guidance to $4.60 billion–$4.64 billion, a $50 million increase at the midpoint; the company also reported repurchasing approximately 0.9 million shares for $122 million during the quarter. (Quiver Quant)
- UBS upgraded Illumina from Neutral to Buy and raised its price target from $135 to $260 on September 9, 2026. (UBS note)
- Illumina announced a $300 million notes offering to refinance 4.650% notes due in September 2026. (company announcement)

- Andra AP-fonden reduced its Affirm position by 89%, selling 141,900 shares and retaining 17,500 shares valued at approximately $1.43 million; the transaction was reported on September 24, 2026. (MarketBeat)
- Affirm’s latest quarterly revenue increased 33.1% year over year, and adjusted earnings exceeded the cited estimate; the report did not provide the relevant actual and consensus figures. (MarketBeat)

## Rocket Lab USA, Inc. (RKLB) `[AI Infrastructure]`
- Iridium shareholders approved Rocket Lab’s proposed acquisition of Iridium on September 24, 2026, with 99.6% of votes cast in favor, representing approximately 81.0% of Iridium’s outstanding shares entitled to vote. (Iridium and Rocket Lab press release)
- The transaction consideration is $27.00 in cash plus Rocket Lab common shares for each Iridium share, with a notional value of $54.00 per Iridium share; completion is targeted for mid-2027, subject to regulatory approvals and other closing conditions. (Iridium and Rocket Lab press release)

## Pershing Square Inc. (PS) `[Investment Management]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window

## Greenland Energy Company (GLND) `[Energy Exploration]`
- Greenland Energy entered a Deed of Variation and Novation with 80 Mile plc and March GL on September 24, 2026, assuming March GL’s rights and obligations under the Jameson Land Basin Farm-Out Agreement. (PR Newswire)
- The longstop date for the first exploration well was extended from December 31, 2026 to December 31, 2028, and the second well’s deadline was extended from December 31, 2027 to December 31, 2028. (PR Newswire)
- Greenland Energy assumed sole responsibility, at its own cost, for securing and maintaining permits and approvals required for the Jameson Land drilling program. (PR Newswire)
- Greenland Energy agreed to pay 80 Mile a £500,000 fee within five business days of the deed’s effective date. (PR Newswire)

## Quantum Corporation (QMCO) `[AI Compute]`
- Quantum reported quarterly EPS of $0.18 versus an expected loss of $0.17 per share and revenue of $80.8 million versus $75.05 million expected. (MarketBeat)
- Quantum shares reached a new 52-week high of $29.15 during the September 24 session. (MarketBeat)

## GRAIL Inc. (GRAL) `[Biotechnology & Diagnostics]`
- The FDA’s Molecular and Clinical Genetics Devices Panel voted 10–0 that GRAIL’s Galleri multi-cancer early-detection test was safe, 7–2 that its benefits outweighed its risks, and 6–4 on effectiveness on September 23, 2026. (Investing.com)
- GRAIL shares reached a 52-week high of $126.81 during the September 24 session following the FDA panel recommendation. (TradingView)

## CareDx, Inc. (CDNA) `[Biotechnology & Diagnostics]`
- CareDx reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of $132 million, up 52% year over year; the cited source gave full-year 2026 revenue estimates of $490 million–$500 million versus $380 million in 2025. (TradingView)
- No separate company-specific announcement dated September 24–25, 2026 was identified in the gathered results. (TradingView)
